notes: All 175 record values (Tables 4-7, 11) checked cell by cell against the PDF: no mismatches. Appendix Tables 8-10 (missing nodes, missing edges, wrong edges) are not in the record. Text says 'six benchmark Bayesian networks' but Table 3 and all result tables have seven. Tables 8-11 values are rounded ('rounded up for comparison'). Appendix A heatmaps (Fig. 2) are figure-only; values not extractable. Appendix A says 'three main hyperparameters' but names only clauses (B) and specificity (S); T and E were not tuned there. Sec. 7.2 prose 'TM performed only 1,428 CI tests' rounds Table 4's 1427.67.
